title: Ad-hoc data chart
description: An agent-authored chart spec rendered to deterministic SVG by the desktop runtime. Panels: metrics, series, bars, scatter, histogram, heatmap, table, note. The pane displays the same rendition a capture returns.

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: Canonical synth.visual.chart-spec.v1 document, supplied as the visual's content.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Evidence the panels were derived from: a trace digest, fixture path, or CAS blob. Recorded for provenance; the spec carries the plotted values.
